push.title: W 11-0 vs Big Creamers | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #6)
push.body:
Perfect Game #6, PhogsToffees. A 10.0 against Big Creamers. If football had a dictionary, your picture would be next to 'flawless'.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 6th Perfect Game for us. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.
+ Goals 10, up from your usual 1. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Tackles won 12, up from your usual 1. Keep stacking those bricks.
+ 2 key passes. That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ Man of the Match, your 16th for us. Man of the Match: the highest compliment the game gives out.

THE BAD
- 12 tackles won pulled 0.9 off. We'll get it back.
- Pass accuracy: 87%. Decent, but top-quarter forwards get to 88%+. That's the next rung.
- Shots on target: 71%. Top-quarter forwards live at 90%+. Let's move in.

Remember, PhogsToffees: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

Rest up, legend. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 11-0 vs Big Creamers | You: 8.5
push.body:
An 8.5 against Big Creamers, BellyTb1. That's the good stuff, the kind you tell your dog about on the drive home.

THE GOOD
+ 1 assist. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is the real deal. Find 'em early and often.
+ 0.9 above your average. Somebody's been doing their homework.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. Proof you've got another gear.
+ Part of an 11-0 beating of Big Creamers. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.

THE BAD
- Only 12 passes (down from your usual 18). Next match: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for. You know you can.
- Only 1 tackle attempted (down from your usual 3). Coach's tip: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes. Like riding a bike.
- Shot accuracy 0%, down from your usual 77%. Game plan: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

Training ground: Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.

Hey, BellyTb1. Pressure is a privilege. It means you're playing for something.

Keep doing you. You're doing great at it. - Coach Lasso
